lines.en: Everyday over one thousand aircraft take-off or land here at Heathrow,
lines.vi: Mỗi ngày có hơn 1000 máy bay cất cánh hoặc hạ cánh ở sân bay Heathrow này.

lines.en: the world's busiest international airport.

lines.en: These aircraft carry over a hundred thousand people to and from eighty-five countries.

lines.en: But it wasn't always like this.
lines.vi: Nhưng không phải lúc nào cũng vậy.

lines.en: The first people to fly across the Atlantic were Alcock and Brown in 1919.
lines.vi: Người đầu tiên bay qua Ðại Tây Dương là Alcock sinh năm 1919.

lines.en: Planes were small and slow then.
lines.vi: Máy bay lúc đó nhỏ và chậm.

lines.en: They were also cold, uncomfortable, noisy. And sometimes dangerous.
lines.vi: Chúng cũng lạnh, thiếu tiện nghi, ồn ào. Và thỉnh thoảng còn nguy hiểm nữa.

lines.en: And they couldn't fly at night.
lines.vi: Và chúng không thể bay trong đêm.

lines.en: By the Second World War planes could fly to any country in the world,
lines.vi: Ðến đệ nhị thế chiến, máy bay đã có thể bay đến mọi nơi trên thế giới.

lines.en: but there weren't many passenger airports, only military airports.

lines.en: At that time, Heathrow was a small village in the country, with fields all around,
lines.vi: Lúc bấy giờ, Heathrow là một ngôi làng quê nhỏ giữa đồng

lines.en: but only fifteen miles from the centre of London.

lines.en: The fields were flat and open - just right for planes to take off and land.

lines.en: Heathrow Airport opened on 1 January 1946.
lines.vi: Sân bay Heathrow được xây dựng vào ngày 1-1-1946.

lines.en: At first it was small and there weren't any buildings, just tents for the customs.

lines.en: Plane tickets were very expensive, so only rich people could travel by air.
lines.vi: Vé bay thì lại rất đắt, chỉ có người giàu mới có thể đi máy bay.

lines.en: By 1950, Heathrow was the busiest airport in Europe.

lines.en: There were new jets which were fast, safe and comfortable,

lines.en: and more people could buy plane tickets.

lines.en: In 1955, two point six million passengers used Heathrow.

lines.en: In 1965, there were ten point six million passengers.

lines.en: By 1980, there were twenty-seven million.
